BruFin 0.6.3 fixes Android launcher icon clipping.

- Reduced the cup artwork to fit Android adaptive icon masks, including themed icons.
- Updated legacy launcher and APK preview icons to match the current design.
- Corrected an Android resource override that still used the older artwork.

Install the signed APK over your existing release app to retain your data and server pairing. The homelab SVG icons now use the same generous padding. Docker images are available as diamachi/brufin:v0.6.3 and latest. Keep your existing data volume when updating; no database reset is required.
